source.question: When was well F-11 B completed, and how does its completion report's timing compare with when it started producing?

note: Fair: dates read off the time-depth chart cited without the look_at_page evidence; calculations from 42 and 22, which no evidence holds. Oct 28: the summary now gets the findings' checks; its '2 days later' is the same unsupported duration as finding 2.

submission.summary: Well 15/9-F-11 B (producer F-11) was completed in late June–July 2013 with handover on 22 July 2013, and first oil followed 2 days later on 24 July 2013. Its Final Well Report (Completion) was issued as Final on 4 September 2013, about 42 days after production started.

findings.claim: Well F-11 B Run Completion was 30 June 2013 14:15 to 4 July 2013 20:00, with Perforation 9 July to 21 July and Handover on 22 July 2013.
findings.detail: Operational Sections table on report p5 lists Run Completion, Install Tubing Hanger, Install X-mas Tree and Perforation sequence; TOC p3 lists Handover (22.07.2013 14:00) Offline activity. Report is FINAL WELL REPORT Completion License NO PL046BS Well NO 15/9-F-11 B Valid from 2013-09-04.

findings.claim: First oil from F-11 (wellbore F-11 B) was on 24 July 2013, 2 days after handover and 20 days after Run Completion ended.
findings.detail: list_wells first_oil 2013-07-24; daily production shows 2013-07-24 17.85 Sm3 on 7h after zero on 2013-07-20 to 2013-07-23; monthly July 2013 had 8 producing days. Handover 22 July to first oil 24 July = 2 days; Run Completion end 4 July to first oil 24 July = 20 days.

findings.claim: The completion report was finalised on 4 September 2013, 42 days after first oil.
findings.detail: Document issued 2013-09-04 per title page and p6 header; interval 24 July to 4 September = 7 days remaining July + 31 days August + 4 days September = 42 days.
